items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I wrote 'Lover Man' and Jimmy Davis did the lyrics for that.

ctx.x: Yeah, but it wasn't "Lover Man" yet. Because I just sketched it out, you know. It was great. Jimmy Davis came up with the title of "Lover Man." I said, "Let's do something...give it some kind of rhythm."
